channel.title: SEO Facts
channel.description: An open reference of search engine optimisation statistics.

item.title: Why the organic traffic share is the number to watch
item.description: A single share figure shapes budgets, hiring and expectations. Here is how to read it without over-claiming.

item.title: The 2,320-word question
item.description: Average length of a top result is a description of what ranks, not an instruction for what to write.

item.title: Core Web Vitals in 2026: a floor, not a finish line
item.description: Passing the thresholds is table stakes. What separates sites is how consistently they pass in the field.

item.title: Link velocity matters less than link fit
item.description: The median top page earns about three new referring domains a month. Chasing that number directly tends to backfire.

item.title: Local intent and the map pack
item.description: Nearly half of searches carry local intent, but the map pack only appears for a subset. Knowing which is which changes the work.

item.title: Measuring SEO ROI without fooling yourself
item.description: The average return is $2.50 per dollar. The variance around that average is the story.
